definition: the strengths my harness gets to a finish that my executive function could not have alone

settled:
It routes four things into work: hyperfocus, depth across several streams at once, systematic precision, and how far my pattern recognition reaches.

Without it those sit behind an executive function that cannot get them to a finish.

Under interest my sustained attention runs about twelve hours a day. For the first four months of this year I averaged twelve hours of AI coding a day. Over the past six weeks that has slowed to eight to ten, and I have stopped tracking it. The slowdown coincides with a more turbulent, higher-stress stretch. I note it lightly.

The volume is the harness rather than raw effort. The teams carry the state of every piece of work, and I hold none of it.

It did a dated job as well as the standing one. Building it out relieved the constraint executive function used to be, and it is one of the three things that moved my bottleneck on to safety.

Necessary rather than sufficient. Nervous system recovery did the larger share of that move.
